recognize_zh: Granzyme B染色可見多個中大型細胞的細胞質呈顆粒狀棕色陽性，陽性顆粒聚集於核周，而多數小細胞為陰性；表示腫瘤細胞帶有細胞毒性表型，常見於ALCL。
features: Coarse granular cytoplasmic granzyme B staining in scattered intermediate-to-large cells
Granules concentrated in a perinuclear distribution
Variable proportion of positive cells with many negative cells
Fine dot-like extracellular granular background staining
describe_en: Granzyme B immunostain shows coarse granular cytoplasmic staining in a subset of intermediate-to-large cells, often perinuclear, with many cells negative. The granular pattern is characteristic of cytotoxic granule protein expression. Expression of cytotoxic markers supports a T-cell (cytotoxic) phenotype in anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which is useful when pan-T-cell antigens are lost.

ddx.dx: Reactive cytotoxic T cells or NK cells
ddx.vs: Reactive cytotoxic cells are small and few, whereas positivity in large atypical CD30+ cells indicates neoplastic expression.
ENKTL is also cytotoxic but is EBER-positive, CD56-positive and angiocentric with necrosis, and CD30 is not uniform.
DUSP22-rearranged cases are usually negative for cytotoxic markers, so strong granzyme B favors a non-DUSP22 subtype.
